Sanming Haisifu Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is located in the Minxi Economic Development Zone, Sanming City, Fujian Province. It is a national high-tech enterprise that researches, develops, and manufactures high-end fluorine-containing fine chemicals and battery chemicals. It has been recognized as a national "Little Giant" specialized and sophisticated enterprise, a national single-product champion in manufacturing, and a national green factory, among other titles. It is a core member of Shenzhen Capchem Technology Co., Ltd. (stock code 300037). The completed and operating plant covers 309 mu, with nearly 1,000 employees, about 200 of whom are technical staff.
Haisifu mainly produces downstream fine chemicals based on hexafluoropropylene, in twelve major product series: fluorine-containing pharmaceutical and pesticide intermediates, fluororubber vulcanizing agents, fluoropolymer modifying comonomers, fluorine solvent cleaning agents for electronics and displays, fluorinated surfactants, fluorinated polyimide monomers for flexible displays and electronics, lithium battery chemicals, perfluoropolyether base oils for greases and vacuum pump oils, fluorinated gases for IC etching and power insulation, fluorinated coolants for data centers, fluorine monomers for photoresists and anti-fouling and moisture-proof coatings, and other specialty chemicals.
Haisifu operates the world's first kiloton-scale industrial production line for perfluoroisobutyronitrile (C4F7N). It has independently developed a green production process and built a complete system for producing, testing, and recovering exhaust gas from pure and mixed-gas perfluoroisobutyronitrile. The product is supplied in volume to mainstream power equipment manufacturers at home and abroad and has earned high recognition from customers in both markets.
Haisifu has passed certifications including ISO 9001 (quality management), ISO 14001 (environmental management), ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety), ISO 50001 (energy management), and IATF 16949 (automotive quality management).
Haisifu has worked in fluorine fine chemicals for more than ten years. With a complete R&D, sales, and technical support system, it is one of the fluorine fine chemical companies in the industry with a relatively complete industrial chain.
Haisifu's mission is to create a better future with fluorine chemicals and fluorine materials.

三明市海斯福化工有限责任公司（简称海斯福， 英文简称HEXAFLU0) 成立于2007年，位于福建省三明市明溪经济开发区，是一家研发及生产高端含氟精细化学品和电池化学品的国家高新技术企业，荣获国家专精特新 “小巨人”企业、国家制造业单项冠军企业、国家绿色工厂等称号，是深圳新宙邦科技股份有限公司（股票代码300037)的核心成员， 已建成投产厂区占地309亩， 拥有员工近1000人，其中科技人员约200人。
海斯福主要生产以六氟丙烯为原料的下游精细化学品，包括含氟医药农药中间体、氟橡胶硫化剂、氟聚合物改性共聚单体、电子与显示用氟溶剂清洗剂、含氟表面活性剂、柔性显示与电子用氟聚酰亚胺单体、锂电池化学品、润滑脂全氟聚醚基础油与真空泵油、IC蚀刻与电力绝缘含氟气体、数据中心含氟冷却液、光刻胶与防污防潮涂层氟单体、其他类特殊化学品等共十二大系列产品。
海斯福拥有全球首条千吨级全氟异丁腈产业化产线，自主开发绿色生产工艺，构建了完善的全氟异丁腈纯气/混合气生产、检测及废气回收体系，产品已批量化供应给国内外主流的电力装备企业，赢得了国内外客户的高度认可。
海斯福公司先后通过了ISO9001质量管理体系 、ISO14001环境管理体系、ISO45001职业健康安全管理体系、ISO50001能源管理体系及 IATF16949汽车行业质量管理体系等体系认证。
海斯福深耕氟精细化学品十余载， 经建立完善的研发 销售及技术支持体系，是行业内拥有较为完整产业链的氟精细化学品企业之 海斯福的使命是用氟化学品和氟材料创造美好未来

pr: HEXAFLUO power insulation gas perfluoroisobutyronitrile (C4F7N) is a sustainable alternative to sulfur hexafluoride (SF6). It is used for insulation and arc quenching in electrical equipment, with applications including gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), gas-insulated lines (GIL), and circuit breakers. Haisifu operates the world's first kiloton-scale industrial production line for perfluoroisobutyronitrile, has independently developed a green production process, and has built a complete system for producing, testing, and recovering exhaust gas from pure and mixed-gas perfluoroisobutyronitrile. The product is supplied in volume to mainstream power equipment manufacturers at home and abroad and has earned high recognition from customers in both markets.
HEXAFLUO电力绝缘气体全氟异丁腈(C4F7N)是六氟化硫(SF6)的可持续替代品，可用于电气设备的绝缘和灭弧，应用场景包括气体绝缘开关设备(GIS)气体绝缘线路(GIL)和断路器等。海斯福拥有全球首条千吨级全氟异丁腈产业化产线，自主开发绿色生产工艺，构建了完善的全氟异丁腈纯气/混合气生产、检测及废气回收体系，产品已批量化供应给国内外主流的电力装备企业，赢得了国内外客户的高度认可。
数据中心浸没式冷却液，储能冷却液

HEXAFLU0 immersion coolant products are chemically resistant, non-toxic, and have excellent dielectric properties. They have no flash point, no fire point, and low viscosity, with zero ozone depletion potential and good material compatibility. They can be used as immersion coolants for data centers, high-performance heat transfer fluids, high-precision temperature-control coolants for semiconductors, and electronic leak-detection fluids. They are widely used in data centers, telecommunications, electronics, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, LCD display manufacturing, precision electronics manufacturing, and related fields.
HEXAFLU0 浸没式冷却液产品，具有耐化学性，无毒性，卓越的介电性能，无闪点， 无燃点，低粘度， 零臭氧消耗潜能值， 优秀的材料兼容性等特点，可用作数据中心浸没式冷却液、 高性能热传导液、半导体用高精度控温冷却液、电子检漏液等，被广泛应用于数据中心、通信、电子、制药、化工、液晶显视屏制造、 精密电子制造等。
